title: accordion find in page misses collapsed
rule: Accordion: hidden copy is invisible to Find in page — browsers’ find does not match collapsed accordion text. Dual-cite USWDS “use only if users need a few pieces”; this names the find-in-page failure.
pass_when: Content people must find with Find in page is not only inside a collapsed accordion.
fail_when: Essential copy lives only in collapsed accordion panels (Find in page cannot match it).
overview: Do not put Find-in-page–essential copy only inside collapsed accordion panels.
apply_when: Accordions hold copy users may search for with Find in page.
not_when: Non-essential details users need only after intentional expand.
agent_hint: Keep Find-in-page–needed copy outside collapsed-only accordion panels.
description: Browsers’ Find in page does not match collapsed accordion text, so hidden copy is invisible to find. Dual-cite USWDS “use only if users need a few pieces”; this row names the find-in-page failure. Pass when content people must find with Find in page is not only inside a collapsed accordion; fail when essential copy lives only in collapsed panels Find cannot match.
do_not_claim: USWDS accordion-sparingly as a merge that drops the find-in-page name.
